SELECT region, avg(value) AS value FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, quantileExactInclusive(0.75)(value) AS value FROM data WHERE ts >= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1 - 300, 3) AND ts <= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1, 3) GROUP BY region, service, job, label_0) GROUP BY region

SELECT region, avg(value) AS value FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, quantileExactInclusive(0.90)(value) AS value FROM data WHERE ts >= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1 - 300, 3) AND ts <= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1, 3) GROUP BY region, service, job, label_0) GROUP BY region

SELECT region, service, job, label_0, sum(value) AS value FROM data WHERE ts >= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 2) * 2 - 180, 3) AND ts <= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 2) * 2, 3) GROUP BY region, service, job, label_0 ORDER BY value DESC, region, service, job, label_0 LIMIT 8 BY region

SELECT region, service, job, label_0, sum(value) AS value FROM data WHERE ts >= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 60) * 60 - 3600, 3) AND ts <= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 60) * 60, 3) GROUP BY region, service, job, label_0 ORDER BY value DESC, region, service, job, label_0 LIMIT 8 BY region, service

SELECT region, service, job, label_0, delta * (sampled + to_start + to_end) / sampled AS value FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, last_v - first_v AS delta, first_v, last_t - first_t AS sampled, sampled / (n - 1) AS avg_step, if(first_t - (intDiv({{ end_time }}, 20) * 20 - 1800) >= 1.1 * avg_step, avg_step / 2, first_t - (intDiv({{ end_time }}, 20) * 20 - 1800)) AS to_start_clamped, if(delta > 0 AND first_v >= 0, least(to_start_clamped, sampled * first_v / delta), to_start_clamped) AS to_start, if(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 20) * 20 - last_t >= 1.1 * avg_step, avg_step / 2, intDiv({{ end_time }}, 20) * 20 - last_t) AS to_end FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, argMin(value, ts) AS first_v, argMax(value, ts) AS last_v, toFloat64(min(ts)) AS first_t, toFloat64(max(ts)) AS last_t, count() AS n FROM data_total WHERE ts >= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 20) * 20 - 1800, 3) AND ts <= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 20) * 20, 3) GROUP BY region, service, job, label_0 HAVING n >= 2)) ORDER BY value DESC, region, service, job, label_0 LIMIT 8 BY region, service

SELECT region, service, job, label_0, delta * (sampled + to_start + to_end) / sampled / 3600 AS value FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, last_v - first_v AS delta, first_v, last_t - first_t AS sampled, sampled / (n - 1) AS avg_step, if(first_t - (intDiv({{ end_time }}, 60) * 60 - 3600) >= 1.1 * avg_step, avg_step / 2, first_t - (intDiv({{ end_time }}, 60) * 60 - 3600)) AS to_start_clamped, if(delta > 0 AND first_v >= 0, least(to_start_clamped, sampled * first_v / delta), to_start_clamped) AS to_start, if(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 60) * 60 - last_t >= 1.1 * avg_step, avg_step / 2, intDiv({{ end_time }}, 60) * 60 - last_t) AS to_end FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, argMin(value, ts) AS first_v, argMax(value, ts) AS last_v, toFloat64(min(ts)) AS first_t, toFloat64(max(ts)) AS last_t, count() AS n FROM data_total WHERE ts >= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 60) * 60 - 3600, 3) AND ts <= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 60) * 60, 3) GROUP BY region, service, job, label_0 HAVING n >= 2)) ORDER BY value DESC, region, service, job, label_0 LIMIT 4 BY region, service
